items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: I always talk of him, but I don't know him personally.

ctx.x: Well, he could always read good. He was a first class musician, but he would get off the music and jazz too. He had these little things he would put in, little runs in between and so forth. I think he's a wonderful man.
There were some other older pianists before your time, I guess Tony Jackson. Did you ever hear him?
I always talk of him, but I don't know him personally.
